_about: Keyword library for the factions board in Miro. tools/miro-sync.js reads this, src/factions.json and src/default-roster.json, tags every item with keywords (rules in the script, skill types below, extras in items) and redraws the board. See docs/MIRO-SYNC.md.

keywords.name: Builder
keywords.text: a unit that builds turrets and building sites during fights

keywords.name: Construct
keywords.text: built bodies: turrets, healbots, cogbots and built buildings

keywords.name: Built building
keywords.text: a site a builder finishes over fights (Factory, Altar)

keywords.name: Lesser building
keywords.text: a round-pick building: stands still, may have aura, income or spawn

keywords.name: Spawn
keywords.text: new bodies made during the fight

keywords.name: Heal and repair
keywords.text: health back to units, buildings or the tower

keywords.name: Aura
keywords.text: squads that start next to it get a bonus

keywords.name: Displace
keywords.text: knockback and pushes

keywords.name: Slow
keywords.text: enemies move and attack slower

keywords.name: Shortsight
keywords.text: cuts the range of enemies it hits

keywords.name: Mines
keywords.text: hidden damage on the ground

keywords.name: Tile spells
keywords.text: zones and strikes cast on a tile for gold

keywords.name: Walls
keywords.text: blocks enemies have to go around or break

keywords.name: Income
keywords.text: extra gold every round

keywords.name: Extra deploys
keywords.text: more deployments every round

keywords.name: When destroyed
keywords.text: you lose health or gold if it falls

keywords.name: Armor
keywords.text: flat damage off every hit

keywords.name: Shield
keywords.text: blocks a number of whole hits

keywords.name: Ward
keywords.text: no single hit can deal more than a cap

keywords.name: Health boost
keywords.text: more max health

keywords.name: Linked health
keywords.text: a squad's bodies share one health pool

keywords.name: Attack speed
keywords.text: attacks more often, including spin-up, frenzy and extra turrets

keywords.name: Damage boost
keywords.text: hits harder

keywords.name: Splash
keywords.text: hits several enemies at once (splash, split beams)

keywords.name: Range boost
keywords.text: reaches farther

keywords.name: Run-through
keywords.text: rolls or tramples through bodies, hitting each one

keywords.name: Move speed
keywords.text: moves, or gets up to speed, faster

keywords.name: Kite
keywords.text: keeps away from enemies while shelling their back line

keywords.name: Transform
keywords.text: changes form mid-fight or mid-match

keywords.name: Death effects
keywords.text: something happens when a body dies

keywords.name: Stealth
keywords.text: can't be targeted until it attacks

keywords.name: Disguise
keywords.text: looks like another unit until its first attack

keywords.name: Burn
keywords.text: damage over time from fire

keywords.name: Poison
keywords.text: damage over time that ignores armor; poisoned units move 20% slower and heal 50% less

skillTypes._about: What each skill type gives the unit that buys it. has = the unit has or gives it, makes = puts it on the board for others, feeds = gets a payoff from it.

items._about: Design intent the data can't show: add has / makes / feeds / counteredBy (keyword lists), why (shown on the line), or not (keywords to drop). Keyed by item name.

Rollers.why: Rollers need speed to roll in
